findings.evidence: Determinacy.lean:107 defines `H := fun _ x xi _ => if 1 < |xi| then 0 else (Icc 0 1).indicator …`; grep for `Model.ofPolynomial` inside `simp`/`simpa` brackets gives lines 124, 126, 133, 140, 141, 155, 156, 204. Contrast MomentDeterminacy.lean:113-117 (`polynomialMomentsIcc_apply`, "whose body is not exposed") and Moments.lean:66-79.
findings.fix: Add `Model.ofPolynomial_H` (the `if … then 0 else indicator …` form, `rfl`) plus `Model.ofPolynomial_H_of_one_lt_abs` and `Model.ofPolynomial_H_of_notMem_Icc` as `@[simp]` lemmas, and rewrite the eight `simp [Model.ofPolynomial, …]` sites through them; likewise give `mellinMomentH_ofPolynomial` a companion for `1 < |xi|` instead of the inline branch at line 204. This is the convention the same PR already follows for `mellinMomentGpd_eq_integral` and `polynomialMomentsIcc_apply`, whose docstring (MomentDeterminacy.lean line 113) states the reason: the body is not exposed.
findings.issue: `Model.ofPolynomial` has no unfolding lemma for `H`: only `ofPolynomial_E` and the partial `ofPolynomial_H_of_mem_Icc`. Every proof therefore re-unfolds the raw definition — `simp [Model.ofPolynomial, …]` at lines 124, 126, 133, 140, 141, 155, 156 and 204 — and the two facts those unfoldings keep re-deriving (`1 < |xi| → H = 0`, and `x ∉ Icc 0 1 → H = 0`) are each proved three times inline (124/126/140 and 204, where the `1 < |xi|` branch re-proves that the moment vanishes, next to `mellinMomentH_ofPolynomial`). Since this file uses plain `public section` (not `@[expose] public section` as `GPD/Moments.lean` line 39 does), the body is not exposed, so no caller can reproduce them either.

summary: Proofs are short, comment-structured, free of `show`/`change`, and the automation used (`fun_prop`, `filter_upwards`, `simp only` with named lemmas) is robust. The one defect is `Model.ofPolynomial`, whose body is unfolded by `simp` in eight places instead of through unfolding lemmas, leaving the facts those unfoldings re-derive unavailable (the file is not `@[expose]`).
